definitions.explanation: A flat piece with teeth used for arranging and styling hair.

examples.japanese: {櫛|くし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦とかす→とかす：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Comb one's hair with a comb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{櫛|くし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}していた→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: She was running a comb through her hair in front of the mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{櫛|くし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形見|かたみ}→形見：12505_katami⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This wooden comb is a memento from my grandmother.
I comb my hair before leaving the house in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧{櫛|くし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カバン→カバン：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: When I travel, I always put a small comb in my bag and take it with me.

notes:
{櫛|くし} refers to a traditional comb for styling hair. In modern Japanese, ⟦ブラシ→ブラシ：01503_burashi⟧ (brush) is often used for everyday hair care, while {櫛|くし} tends to refer to traditional flat combs.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {櫛|くし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to comb, to put a comb through)
- {櫛|くし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to run a comb through)
- {櫛|くし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧ (like the teeth of a comb; in a row)

NOTE ON KANJI: The kanji {櫛|くし} is not commonly used in everyday writing. Often written in hiragana as くし.
